name: ui-dropzone
description: Drop / pick / paste files: hand-over events or a form field with a file list; accept, size and count limits with messages.

descriptions.--ui-dropzone-gap: Space between icon, text and hint.
descriptions.--ui-dropzone-over-color: Text colour while files are dragged over (theme: its fg).
descriptions.--ui-dropzone-over-bg: Background while files are dragged over (theme: its subtle bg).
descriptions.--ui-dropzone-over-border-color: Border colour while files are dragged over (theme: its bg).
